q: For a Markov chain with transition matrix P and stationary distribution π, the entropy rate is:
opts: h = -∑ᵢ πᵢ ∑ⱼ Pᵢⱼ log Pᵢⱼ (weighted sum of row entropies)
exp: For an ergodic Markov chain: h = H(X₁|X₀) = -∑ᵢπᵢ∑ⱼPᵢⱼlog Pᵢⱼ = ∑ᵢπᵢH(Pᵢ·). The entropy rate is the stationary average of the row entropies — how uncertain is the next state given the current state, averaged over the stationary distribution.
